gold_rationale: flat $10,000/day rate regardless of governing schedule
report_explanation: A universal invented flat daily rate replaces the value-based Section 108.9 schedule and expressly overrides it ('regardless of contract value or governing schedule'). Per checklist guidance this is a material deviation. Precedence note: Special Provisions rank below General Notices but above Standard Specifications under DelDOT 105.6, so this clause would otherwise control - which increases, not reduces, the review risk. Magnitude context: $10,000/day against an assumed contract value of $480,000.
